en.headline: APEC finance ministers agree to strengthen policy coordination
en.dek: The two-day meeting in Hong Kong wrapped up with a joint statement and a policy paper on digital infrastructure financing, according to Chinese Finance Minister Lan Foan.
body: Chinese Finance Minister Lan Foan said the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting achieved practical results as it concluded in Hong Kong on Wednesday.

Members agreed to strengthen macroeconomic communication and coordination to cope with external risks and challenges, he said at a press conference. They also agreed to enhance the soundness of macroeconomic policies, boost the resilience of fiscal and financial systems, and safeguard regional economic and financial stability.

The meeting issued the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers’ Joint Statement and a policy statement on enhancing regional cooperation on digital infrastructure financing. Lan said members highlighted the importance of boosting household spending and domestic demand, and of unlocking the potential of technologies such as artificial intelligence.

On digital infrastructure, economies encouraged the public sector to create a favourable policy and supervisory environment while supporting private-sector funding and innovative financing, according to the minister.

zh.headline: APEC財長會議結束 同意加強宏觀政策協調
zh.dek: 會議周三在香港閉幕，中國財政部部長藍佛安表示成員同意加強宏觀經濟溝通協調，並發表聯合聲明及數字基礎設施融資政策文件。
body: 中國財政部部長藍佛安表示，在香港舉行的亞太經合組織財政部長會議取得實質成果，會議周三結束。
藍佛安在記者會上說，成員同意加強宏觀經濟溝通與協調，以應對外部風險和挑戰。他們亦同意提升宏觀政策穩健性、增強財政金融體系韌性，並維護區域經濟金融穩定。
會議發表了2026年APEC財政部長聯合聲明，以及加強區域數字基礎設施融資合作的政策聲明。藍佛安指成員強調促進家庭支出和內需的重要性，並充分釋放人工智能等新興技術潛力。
在數字基礎設施方面，經濟體鼓勵公共部門營造有利政策和監管環境，同時支持私人部門提供資金及創新融資方式。
